name_en: Unique factorization of ideals in Dedekind domains
canonical_claim: Every nonzero integral ideal of a Dedekind domain has unique prime-ideal factorization; proper nonzero ideals factor into nonzero prime ideals and the unit ideal has the empty factorization.
